convention.world: CozyClay Studio / Three.js scene: right-handed, +Y up, metres. The character's front is +Z at azimuth 0.
convention.worldToCamera: OpenCV: [X Y Z 1]^T = worldToCamera * [x y z 1]^T, camera x right, y DOWN, z forward (depth).
convention.projection: u = fx * X / Z + cx, v = fy * Y / Z + cy. Square pixels, no distortion, no skew.
convention.image: Pixels continuous from the top-left corner of the top-left pixel: u right, v DOWN; pixel (col,row) covers [col,col+1)x[row,row+1) and its centre is (col+0.5,row+0.5); cx = width/2, cy = height/2.
convention.worldToCameraGl: Three/OpenGL view matrix (camera.matrixWorldInverse): x right, y up, looking down -z.
convention.threeCamera: PerspectiveCamera(fov = fovDeg vertical, aspect = width/height), position, rotation.set(pitch, yaw, 0) with order YXZ (radians); rendered through the Studio export capture.
convention.gvhmr: Run GVHMR with --f-mm gvhmrFMm: f_px = sqrt(W^2 + H^2) / sqrt(24^2 + 36^2) * f_mm equals fx = fy here.
